endpoint.description: Base URL of the Forge API. Defaults to `https://forge.laravel.com`. May also be set via `FORGE_ENDPOINT`.

token.description: Laravel Forge API token. May also be set via the `FORGE_TOKEN` environment variable.

block.description: Manage [Laravel Forge](https://forge.laravel.com) resources as code.

command.description: Command the daemon runs. Changing it recreates the daemon.

directory.description: Working directory the command runs in. Changing it recreates the daemon.

id.description: Numeric ID of the daemon.

server_id.description: ID of the server to create the daemon on.

user.description: User account the command runs under. Changing it recreates the daemon.

block.description: Manages a daemon (background process) on a Laravel Forge server.

id.description: Numeric ID of the database.

password.description: Password for the database user. Only used when `user` is set. Create-only; not returned by the API.

server_id.description: ID of the server to create the database on.

user.description: Optional database user to create alongside the database. Create-only; not returned by the API.

block.description: Manages a database (schema) on a Laravel Forge server. Forge has no update endpoint for databases, so every input is replace-only.

id.description: Numeric ID of the database user.

name.description: Name of the database user. Create-only.

password.description: Password for the database user. Write-only (never returned by the API) and create-only.

read_only.description: Whether the user should have read-only access to its databases. Create-only.

server_id.description: ID of the server the database user belongs to.

block.description: Manages a database user on a Laravel Forge server. The only mutable attribute exposed by the API on update is the set of assigned databases (a list, not modelled in this pass), so all attributes here are create-only and changes force replacement.

id.description: Numeric ID of the firewall rule.

ip_address.description: IP address or subnet the rule applies to.

port.description: Port or port range for the firewall rule.

server_id.description: ID of the server to create the firewall rule on.

block.description: Manages a firewall rule on a Laravel Forge server. Firewall rules cannot be updated in place; any change forces a replacement.

id.description: Numeric ID of the monitor.

minutes.description: Frequency in minutes to evaluate the monitor. Cannot be changed in place.

notify.description: Email address notified when the monitor is in an alert state. Cannot be changed in place.

operator.description: Comparison operator against the threshold (`gte` or `lte`). Cannot be changed in place.

server_id.description: ID of the server the monitor belongs to.

state.description: Current state of the monitor (`OK`, `ALERT`, or `UNKNOWN`).

state_changed_at.description: Timestamp the monitor state last changed.

threshold.description: Percentage threshold to alert on once breached. Cannot be changed in place.

type.description: Metric type (`cpu_load`, `disk`, `free_memory`, or `used_memory`). Cannot be changed in place.

block.description: Manages a server monitor on a Laravel Forge server. Forge monitors cannot be edited in place, so every configurable attribute forces replacement. Requires the Business plan.

content.description: Nginx configuration template content (supports Forge variable substitution).

id.description: Numeric ID of the nginx template.

server_id.description: ID of the server the template belongs to.

block.description: Manages a custom nginx template on a Laravel Forge server.

id.description: ID of the role.

block.description: Manages a custom role within a Laravel Forge organization.

cloud_provider.description: Provider the credential authenticates against, e.g. `Hetzner Cloud` (Forge API `provider`; renamed because `provider` is reserved in HCL).

credential_id.description: ID of the server credential to share with the team.

in_use.description: Whether the credential is currently in use by a server.

team_id.description: ID of the team the credential is shared with.

block.description: Shares an organization server credential with a team in Laravel Forge. This manages the share linkage only (created on POST, removed on DELETE); the credential object itself is read-only. There is no update — any change recreates the share.

credential.description: ID of the server credential used to reach the provider.

id.description: ID of the VPC at the provider.

region.description: Provider region the VPC is created in.

block.description: Manages a VPC (private network) created at a server provider via a Forge organization's server credential and region. The Forge API exposes only create and read for VPCs (no update, no delete), so this resource is create-and-read only: every attribute is create-time, and destroying the resource removes it from state without deleting the VPC at the provider.

access_key.description: Access key for the storage provider. Write-only; never returned by the API.

assume_role.description: Whether to use an EC2 assumed IAM role instead of access/secret keys.

id.description: Numeric ID of the storage provider.

in_use.description: Whether the storage provider is currently used by a backup configuration.

name.description: Display name of the storage provider.

secret_key.description: Secret key for the storage provider. Write-only; never returned by the API.

block.description: Manages an organization storage provider (backup destination, e.g. S3) on Laravel Forge.

email.description: Email address of the invited member. Create-only; changing it recreates the invitation.

id.description: Numeric ID of the invitation.

role_id.description: ID of the role to grant the invited member. Create-only; changing it recreates the invitation.

team_id.description: ID of the team to invite the member to.

block.description: Manages a pending invitation to a Laravel Forge team. The API has no update endpoint, so any change recreates the invitation.

id.description: Numeric ID of the user whose membership is managed.

role_id.description: ID of the role assigned to the member within the team.

team_id.description: ID of the team the membership belongs to.

block.description: Manages a user's membership and role within a Laravel Forge team. There is no create endpoint — a member joins a team through the invite flow (`laravelforge_org_team_invite`); this resource adopts an existing membership and manages its role (PUT) and removal (DELETE). It is commonly imported.

recipe_id.description: Numeric ID of the recipe to share with the team.

script.description: Shell script executed by the recipe.

team_id.description: Numeric ID of the team the recipe is shared with.

block.description: Shares an existing recipe with a team in a Laravel Forge organization. This is a link between a team and a recipe; the recipe itself is managed elsewhere. There is no update endpoint, so changing any attribute recreates the share.

cloud_provider.description: Underlying server provider (Forge API `provider`; renamed because `provider` is reserved in HCL).

is_ready.description: Whether the server has finished provisioning.

server_id.description: ID of the server to share with the team.

team_id.description: ID of the team to share the server with.

block.description: Shares an existing Laravel Forge server with a team. This is a link between a team and a server; there is no update path, so any change re-creates the share.

id.description: Numeric ID of the recipe.

script.description: Shell script executed by the recipe.

user.description: User the recipe runs as (`root` or `forge`).

block.description: Manages a recipe (reusable shell script) within a Laravel Forge organization.

id.description: Numeric ID of the redirect rule.

server_id.description: Numeric ID of the server the site belongs to.

site_id.description: Numeric ID of the site to create the redirect rule on.

block.description: Manages a redirect rule on a Laravel Forge site. Redirect rules have no update endpoint, so any change to `from`, `to`, or `type` forces replacement.

cron.description: Cron expression. Required when `frequency` is `custom`; for preset frequencies Forge generates it.

frequency.description: How often the job runs. Sent lowercase: one of `minutely`, `hourly`, `nightly`, `weekly`, `monthly`, `reboot`, `custom`. When `custom`, also set `cron`.

id.description: Numeric ID of the scheduled job.

next_run_time.description: Timestamp of the next scheduled run.

server_id.description: ID of the server to create the scheduled job on.

user.description: System user the command runs as (e.g. `root`).

block.description: Manages a scheduled job (cron job) on a Laravel Forge server. Scheduled jobs are immutable: the Forge API exposes no update endpoint, so any change to a configured attribute replaces the job.

id.description: Numeric ID of the security rule.

server_id.description: Numeric ID of the server the site belongs to.

site_id.description: Numeric ID of the site to attach the rule to.

block.description: Manages a security rule (HTTP basic-auth protection) on a Laravel Forge site. Credentials (username/password) are an object array not managed in this pass.

cloud_provider.description: Underlying server provider (Forge API `provider`; renamed because `provider` is reserved in HCL). Create-only.

credential_id.description: ID of the provider credential to provision with. Create-only.

id.description: Numeric ID of the server.

is_ready.description: Whether the server has finished provisioning.

block.description: Manages a Laravel Forge server within an organization. Provider-specific provisioning blocks (hetzner, aws, …) and tags are not modelled in this pass.

config.description: The supervisor configuration of the background process. Update-only (write-only; not returned by the API).

directory.description: The directory to run the background process from. Create-only.

id.description: Numeric ID of the background process.

name.description: The name of the background process.

processes.description: The number of processes to run.

server_id.description: ID of the server the background process runs on.

site_id.description: The site to associate the background process with. Create-only.

startsecs.description: The number of seconds to wait before starting the process. Create-only.

status.description: The status of the background process.

stopsignal.description: The signal to send to stop the process (e.g. `SIGTERM`). Create-only.

stopwaitsecs.description: The number of seconds to wait before stopping the process. Create-only.

user.description: The user to run the background process as (`root` or `forge`). Create-only.

block.description: Manages a background process (long-running daemon-like process) on a Laravel Forge server.

bucket.description: Storage bucket the backups are written to.

cloud_provider.description: Underlying storage provider (Forge API `provider`; renamed because `provider` is reserved in HCL).

cron.description: Custom cron expression (used when `frequency` is `custom`). Write-only input.

database_ids.description: IDs of the databases to back up. Write-only input (not round-tripped into state).

day.description: Day of week for weekly backups (`0`-`6`). Write-only input.

day_of_week.description: Day of week the backup runs (`0`-`6`), if weekly.

id.description: Numeric ID of the backup configuration.

next_run_time.description: Timestamp of the next scheduled run.

notification_email.description: Email address notified on backup events. Write-only input; the API reports it back as `notify_email`.

notify_email.description: Email address notified on backup events.

server_id.description: ID of the server the backup configuration belongs to.

storage_provider_id.description: ID of the storage provider (credential) the backups are written to.

time.description: Time of day the backup runs (e.g. `03:00`).

block.description: Manages a database backup configuration (schedule, retention, storage provider) on a Laravel Forge server.

server_id.description: ID of the server whose network membership is managed.

servers.description: Set of server IDs that should be in this server's network.

block.description: Manages the private-network membership of a Laravel Forge server: the set of other server IDs it can reach. Singleton per server.

configuration.description: php.ini CLI configuration as reported by Forge.

php_version.description: ID of the PHP version whose CLI config is managed.

server_id.description: ID of the server.

block.description: Manages the php.ini CLI configuration for a given PHP version on a Laravel Forge server. Singleton per PHP version (GET show + PUT update only).

server_id.description: ID of the server whose CLI PHP version is managed.

status.description: Installation status of the PHP version.

version.description: Active CLI PHP version reported by Forge.

block.description: Manages the default CLI PHP version of a Laravel Forge server (singleton). Selects which installed PHP version the `php` CLI points to.

php_version.description: PHP version key whose php-fpm configuration is managed (e.g. `php82`).

server_id.description: ID of the server the PHP version belongs to.

block.description: Manages the php-fpm configuration for a given PHP version on a Laravel Forge server. The configuration is a singleton on the server's PHP version (no separate ID): it is read via `GET` and replaced via `PUT`, and removing the resource leaves the configuration in place (Forge has no destroy endpoint for it).

server_id.description: ID of the server whose PHP max execution time is managed.

block.description: Manages the PHP `max_execution_time` setting on a Laravel Forge server. This is a singleton per server: it has no own ID, cannot be destroyed (delete is a no-op), and apply just PUTs the desired value.

server_id.description: ID of the server whose PHP max upload size is managed.

block.description: Manages the PHP max upload size (`upload_max_filesize` / `post_max_size`) on a Laravel Forge server. The setting is a singleton on the server (no separate ID): it is read via `GET` and replaced via `PUT`, and removing the resource leaves the current value in place (Forge has no destroy endpoint for it).

opcache_enabled.description: Whether PHP OPcache is enabled on the server.

server_id.description: ID of the server to enable PHP OPcache on.

block.description: Enables PHP OPcache on a Laravel Forge server. This is a singleton toggle: creating the resource enables OPcache, destroying it disables OPcache. There is no in-place update.

config.description: The php-fpm pool configuration contents to write.

configuration.description: The current php-fpm pool configuration as returned by Forge.

php_version_id.description: ID of the PHP version whose pool config is managed.

server_id.description: ID of the server the PHP version belongs to.

user.description: Optional pool user to scope the configuration to.

block.description: Manages the php-fpm pool configuration of a PHP version on a Laravel Forge server (singleton per PHP version).

php_version.description: PHP version to set as the server's default for sites (e.g. `8.2`).

server_id.description: ID of the server whose default site PHP version is managed.

version.description: PHP version as reported by Forge.

block.description: Manages the default site/FPM PHP version for a Laravel Forge server. Singleton per server (GET show + PUT update only).

cli_default.description: Whether to make this the default CLI PHP version on install. Applied at create time only.

id.description: Numeric ID of the installed PHP version.

server_id.description: ID of the server to install the PHP version on.

site_default.description: Whether to make this the default site PHP version on install. Applied at create time only.

version.description: PHP version key to install (e.g. `php82`). Create-only.

block.description: Installs and manages a PHP version on a Laravel Forge server.

id.description: Numeric ID of the SSH key.

name.description: Display name of the SSH key.

public_key.description: The public key contents. Write-only on create; not returned by the API on read.

server_id.description: ID of the server to add the SSH key to.

username.description: System user the key is installed for (e.g. `forge`).

block.description: Manages an SSH key authorized on a Laravel Forge server. SSH keys are immutable: any change forces replacement (the Forge API offers no update endpoint).

id.description: Numeric ID of the site.

server_id.description: ID of the server to create the site on.

block.description: Manages a site on a Laravel Forge server.

password.description: Password (or token) for the Composer credential.

repository.description: Repository host the credential authenticates against (the credential's identity).

server_id.description: Numeric ID of the server the site belongs to.

site_id.description: Numeric ID of the site the credential belongs to.

block.description: Manages a Composer authentication credential for a repository host on a Laravel Forge site.

server_id.description: ID of the server the site belongs to.

site_id.description: ID of the site whose deploy hook is managed.

url.description: The deployment-trigger URL for the site.

block.description: Manages the deployment-trigger (deploy-hook) URL for a Laravel Forge site. Singleton per site; applying it (re)generates the hook token.

key.description: The public deploy key for the site.

server_id.description: ID of the server that owns the site.

site_id.description: ID of the site the deploy key belongs to.

block.description: Manages the deploy key for a Laravel Forge site. Singleton per site: one deploy key per site, created on POST and removed on DELETE. There is no update — any change recreates it.

auto_source.description: Make `.env` variables available to the deployment script.

content.description: The content of the deployment script.

server_id.description: ID of the server the site belongs to.

site_id.description: ID of the site whose deployment script is managed.

block.description: Manages the deployment script of a Laravel Forge site. The script is a singleton on the site (no separate ID): it is read via `GET` and replaced via `PUT`, and removing the resource leaves the script in place (Forge has no destroy endpoint for it).

allow_wildcard_subdomains.description: Whether the domain allows wildcard subdomains.

id.description: Numeric ID of the domain record.

name.description: The name of the domain (e.g. `laravel.com`). Create-only.

server_id.description: ID of the server hosting the site.

site_id.description: ID of the site the domain belongs to.

block.description: Manages a domain record on a Laravel Forge site.

config.description: Nginx configuration block to apply for the domain.

content.description: Current nginx configuration content as reported by Forge.

domain_record_id.description: ID of the domain record whose nginx config this manages.

server_id.description: ID of the server the site belongs to.

site_id.description: ID of the site the domain record belongs to.

block.description: Manages the per-domain nginx configuration block on a Laravel Forge site. Singleton per domain record (PUT update only, no separate create/destroy).

cache.description: Whether to cache the configuration after updating the environment.

content.description: The current `.env` file contents as returned by Forge.

encryption_key.description: Optional encryption key used to encrypt the environment file.

environment.description: The `.env` file contents to write to the site.

queues.description: Whether to restart the site's queues after updating the environment.

server_id.description: ID of the server the site belongs to.

site_id.description: ID of the site whose environment is managed.

block.description: Manages the `.env` file contents of a Laravel Forge site (singleton per site).

healthcheck_endpoint.description: The endpoint / URL used to perform healthchecks (e.g. `https://my-app.com/up`).

server_id.description: ID of the server the site belongs to.

site_id.description: ID of the site whose healthcheck endpoint is managed.

block.description: Manages the healthcheck endpoint configuration for a Laravel Forge site (singleton).

custom_frequency.description: A cron expression representing the custom frequency at which the client is expected to send a ping, used when `frequency` is set to -1.

frequency.description: The interval (in minutes) at which the client is expected to send a ping. One of 1, 5, 10, 30, 60, 1440, 10080, 312480, or -1 for a custom frequency.

grace_period.description: The duration (in minutes) after which a heartbeat is considered missing. One of 1, 2, 5, 10, 30, 60.

id.description: Numeric ID of the heartbeat.

ping_url.description: The URL the client pings to report a heartbeat.

server_id.description: ID of the server that owns the site.

site_id.description: ID of the site the heartbeat belongs to.

block.description: Manages a cron-style heartbeat monitor on a Laravel Forge site.

enabled.description: Whether the Horizon integration is enabled.

horizon_installed.description: Whether Laravel Horizon is installed on the site.

server_id.description: ID of the server the site belongs to.

site_id.description: ID of the site to enable the Horizon integration on.

block.description: Manages the Laravel Horizon integration of a Laravel Forge site (singleton per site). The presence of the resource means Horizon is enabled; destroying it disables Horizon. There is no update endpoint, so changing any attribute recreates the resource.

enabled.description: Whether the Inertia integration is enabled.

inertia_installed.description: Whether Inertia is installed for the site.

server_id.description: ID of the server that hosts the site.

site_id.description: ID of the site to enable the Inertia integration on.

block.description: Enables the Inertia SSR integration on a Laravel Forge site. This is a per-site singleton; the API has no delete endpoint, so destroying this resource only removes it from state and leaves the integration enabled.

enabled.description: Whether the maintenance mode integration is enabled.

laravel_installed.description: Whether Laravel is installed on the site.

redirect.description: The redirect URL to which all requests are sent while in maintenance mode.

secret.description: The secret phrase that allows access to the application while in maintenance mode.

server_id.description: ID of the server that owns the site.

site_id.description: ID of the site to enable maintenance mode on.

status.description: The status of the maintenance mode integration (`enabling` or `disabling`).

status_code.description: The HTTP status code returned while in maintenance mode. One of 304, 307, 410, 503.

block.description: Enables Laravel maintenance mode for a Laravel Forge site. This is a singleton integration: the presence of the resource means maintenance mode is enabled, and destroying it disables it. The Forge API exposes no update endpoint, so changing any writable input recreates the resource.

enabled.description: Whether the Laravel scheduler integration is enabled.

laravel_installed.description: Whether Laravel is installed on the site.

server_id.description: ID of the server the site belongs to.

site_id.description: ID of the site the integration belongs to.

block.description: Manages the Laravel scheduler integration on a Laravel Forge site. Enabling/disabling has no update path, so changes recreate the resource.

server_id.description: ID of the server that owns the balancer site.

site_id.description: ID of the balancer site.

block.description: Manages the load-balancing node set of a Laravel Forge balancer site (singleton per site).

config.description: Raw Nginx configuration for the site.

server_id.description: ID of the server the site belongs to.

site_id.description: ID of the site.

block.description: Manages the site-level raw Nginx configuration on a Laravel Forge site (singleton per site).

registry.description: The NPM registry URL the credential authenticates against. Acts as the credential's identifier.

server_id.description: ID of the server hosting the site.

site_id.description: ID of the site the credential belongs to.

token.description: The authentication token for the registry.

block.description: Manages NPM registry authentication credentials for a Laravel Forge site, keyed by registry.

enabled.description: Whether the Octane integration is enabled, as reported by Forge.

installed_port.description: Port Octane is configured to listen on, as reported by Forge.

octane_installed.description: Whether the Octane package is installed on the site.

server_id.description: ID of the server the site belongs to.

site_id.description: ID of the site to enable the Octane integration on.

block.description: Manages the Laravel Octane integration for a Laravel Forge site (singleton per site). The presence of the resource means Octane is enabled; destroying it disables Octane. The Forge API exposes no update endpoint, so changing any input forces a destroy and recreate.

enabled.description: Whether the Pulse integration is enabled.

pulse_installed.description: Whether Laravel Pulse is installed on the site.

server_id.description: ID of the server the site belongs to.

site_id.description: ID of the site to enable the Pulse integration on.

block.description: Enables the Laravel Pulse integration on a Laravel Forge site. This is a singleton toggle: the presence of the resource means the integration is enabled, and destroying it disables the integration. There is no update endpoint, so any change forces a destroy+create.

server_id.description: ID of the server the site belongs to.

site_id.description: ID of the site to enable push-to-deploy on.

block.description: Enables push-to-deploy for a Laravel Forge site. This is a singleton toggle: the presence of the resource means push-to-deploy is enabled, and destroying it disables push-to-deploy. The Forge API exposes no read endpoint for this toggle, so its state is tracked solely by Terraform.

connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent connections (1-50000). Changing it recreates the integration.

enabled.description: Whether the Reverb integration is enabled, as reported by Forge.

host.description: Reverb host. Changing it recreates the integration.

installed_connections.description: Maximum concurrent connections as reported by Forge.

installed_host.description: Reverb host as reported by Forge.

installed_port.description: Reverb port as reported by Forge.

port.description: Reverb port. Changing it recreates the integration.

reverb_installed.description: Whether the Reverb package is installed on the site.

server_id.description: ID of the server the site belongs to.

site_id.description: ID of the site to enable Reverb on.

block.description: Manages the Laravel Reverb integration on a Forge site. The integration is a singleton per site; there is no update endpoint, so changing any input recreates it.

active.description: Whether this certificate is the active one for the domain.

certificate.description: Certificate body (PEM, including intermediates) for an `existing` certificate. Create-only.

certificate_id.description: Source certificate ID to copy when `type = clone`. Create-only.

city.description: City / locality for a `new` (CSR) certificate. Create-only.

country.description: Two-letter country code for a `new` (CSR) certificate. Create-only.

department.description: Organizational unit / department for a `new` (CSR) certificate. Create-only.

domain.description: Primary domain the certificate covers. Create-only.

domain_id.description: ID of the domain the certificate is installed on (certificates are scoped per-domain in the new Forge SSL system).

existing.description: Whether the certificate was uploaded (vs. issued by Forge).

id.description: Numeric ID of the team.

block.description: Manages a team within a Laravel Forge organization.

id.description: Numeric ID of the webhook.

site_id.description: Numeric ID of the site to attach the webhook to.

url.description: URL the webhook posts to on deployment. Create-only; changing it replaces the webhook.

block.description: Manages a deployment webhook on a Laravel Forge site. Forge has no update endpoint for webhooks, so any change to `url` replaces the resource.

processes.description: Number of processes the worker runs.

id.description: Numeric ID of the credential.

in_use.description: Whether the credential is currently in use by a server.

organization.description: Slug of the Forge organization that owns the credential.

block.description: Fetches a single Laravel Forge server credential by ID within an organization.

id.description: User ID.

block.description: Fetches the current authenticated Laravel Forge user (singleton).

directory.description: Working directory the command runs in.

id.description: Numeric ID of the daemon.

server_id.description: ID of the server the daemon runs on.

user.description: User account the command runs under.

block.description: Fetches a single Laravel Forge daemon (background process) by ID on a server.

id.description: Numeric ID of the database.

server_id.description: ID of the server the database belongs to.

block.description: Fetches a single Laravel Forge database (schema) by ID on a server.

id.description: Numeric ID of the database user.

server_id.description: ID of the server the database user belongs to.

block.description: Fetches a single Laravel Forge database user by ID on a server.

id.description: Numeric ID of the firewall rule.

ip_address.description: IP address or subnet the rule applies to.

port.description: Port or port range for the firewall rule.

server_id.description: ID of the server the firewall rule belongs to.

block.description: Fetches a single Laravel Forge firewall rule by ID on a server.
